candidates.label: Poudre noire - creation
candidates.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: Victoria 3 PRODUCTION METHOD (PM) icon, lot 9 PREVIEW ONLY. Produce ONE high-resolution SQUARE 1:1 PNG with genuine transparent alpha background and openings. It is a small flat PM pictogram, NOT a realistic picture or a technical plan.
Input 1 is ONLY a reference for native PM colour families and broad icon shapes. Input 2 is ONLY the approved matte beige/ochre PM graphic style. Never copy their depicted subjects, UI, panels, words or layouts.
Primary request: BLACK POWDER, illustrated by exactly TWO principal symbols: a short broad powder barrel, and ONE small flat stylised explosion-star partly behind its upper-right corner. The star is a simple graphic sign, not an actual realistic explosion. The barrel dominates. Simple front elevation, gently curved broad sides, two stout horizontal hoops, a wide top lip with a SMALL cluster of 4-6 broad coarse rounded granules visible at the lip as contents of that barrel. No scattered heap or extra container. Its front has only 2-3 wide vertical stave seams, no many tiny wood details. The single sharp starburst sits close, partly hidden by the barrel, within the compact nearly square silhouette; it remains distinguishable at small sizes. This is a GAME SYMBOL, no recipe, text, label, formula, manufacturing steps, ignition or weapon.
Style: STRICT FLAT TWO-DIMENSIONAL shapes, ONE GLOBAL vertical GRAPHIC colour gradient, pale muted beige at top grading to darker muted ochre at bottom. Fine subtle MATTE grain and discreet dark-brown graphic outlines. All symbols including granules are in the SAME yellow/beige/ochre PRODUCTION family, not green and not red. Fully opaque symbol faces, genuine transparent surroundings and cutouts. Broad shapes and large spaces for legibility at 32 px.
Composition: centred compact whole glyph, generous transparent outer margins, fully inside image. Max TWO main symbols. No perspective, object lighting, local volumetric shading, bevel, relief, 3D, extrusion, metallic gloss, realistic grain, photo, painting, factory, room, background colour, frame, badge, circle enclosing everything, arrows, people, machine, tool, fuse, flame, sparks, smoke, firearm, text, numbers, letters, logo or watermark. Do not make an intricate scene or many independent items.

export.native_exceptions: Nitroglycerin and dynamite stay native 104x104, 7 mips; no copies or re-exports.
